display_long_description:
# BATTERED, BUT STILL UNBEATEN!

**Crêpe Master!** is a fun, solo beat them all adventure in a colorful magical-girl style. Become the reincarnation of the Crêpe Goddess and defend Earth against an alien invasion that threatens the world’s most beloved treat.

# Features

**YOUR WEAPON IS… A PAN!**
[media]

Swing, and bonk with all your energy in a fast, frantic fight. Break their guards, knock them out, and recover the stolen ingredients to save the world.

**MAGICAL GIRL POSE**
[media]

Ever dreamed of being a magical girl and striking those iconic poses? Now you can. Recreate them with your own arms with **gesture-based controls** to invoke Crêpe Magic and unleash powerful spells.

**CRAFT TO BOOST YOUR SPELLS**
[media]

As the adventure intensifies, you’ll need stronger magic. Go into a Crepo-Trance, grab the right ingredients, and cook crêpes at lightning speed to power up your abilities.

**YOUR STORY: YOU ARE HANA, THE REINCARNATION OF THE CRÊPE GODDESS**

In the far reaches of space, a ruthless tyrant has sworn to destroy the crêpe, the universal symbol of joy and community.

On Earth, a student named Hana discovers a ruby-studded pan. By seizing it, she awakens the powers of the legendary Crêpe Goddess.

If the crêpe disappears, the world will fall with it. It’s time to fight back.
